title: My thermostat listed me as a guest 🌡️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:40 in the morning, my thermostat said two people were home.

scenes.narration: At 3:40 in the morning, my thermostat said two people were home.
I live alone. I opened the app. Occupancy, two. One in the bedroom. One in the kitchen.
I was lying in the bedroom. The app drew a small warm dot on my bed. That was me.
The other dot was in the kitchen. It was not moving. It was standing right by the fridge.
I listened. No footsteps. No fridge hum. Only the heating, ticking, as if something had turned it up.
The kitchen dot moved. Slowly. Into the hallway. It stopped outside my room.
The app said, away mode off. Welcome home. And then, a second line. Guests will be reminded to leave.
I tapped on the dots. Names appeared. The hallway dot said, owner.
The lights went out by themselves. The front door locked from the inside. And my phone said, please leave before 4 in the morning.
So tell me. Do you leave, or stay?
